name: photo-hunt-functions
description: Cloud Functions API for the Photo Hunt app

scripts.//build: tsc only type-checks; esbuild does the emit. Bundling inlines the `shared` workspace package (and zod) into lib/index.js, which is what makes deploy work — Cloud Build cannot resolve a workspace symlink.
scripts.//build:watch: No type-check in the watch loop — keep it fast. The emulator reloads whenever lib/ changes.
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions

//dependencies: Only what must exist at RUNTIME in the cloud. Cloud Build installs these from the registry, so nothing here may be a workspace package.
//devDependencies: `shared` is safe here precisely because it is bundled at build time and never installed in the cloud.
